when: Building receives RHS assistance — UA for ALL rent-restricted units is the RHS schedule even if HUD tenants live there.
desk: Pass --ua-method RHS and the RHS dollar UA via --ua. Do not mix PHA.

when: Any tenant in the building receives RHS rental assistance — entire building uses RHS UA (including HUD-assisted units).
desk: Pass --ua-method RHS-TENANT. One RHS tenant flips the building.

when: No RHS building/tenant; HUD regulates rents and UAs (HUD-regulated building).
desk: Pass --ua-method HUD-REG with the HUD schedule dollar via --ua.

when: Other buildings: unit occupied by a tenant receiving HUD tenant assistance (Section 8).
desk: Pass --ua-method PHA-S8. PHA Existing Housing UA. HAP itself is excluded from gross rent (42(g)(2)(B)(i)); pass --s8-hap.

when: None of (b)(1)–(b)(4)(i) apply. Default is the applicable PHA UA unless an owner election below is in force.
Local utility company written estimate for similar size/construction. Not available to (b)(1)–(b)(4)(i) units. Once obtained
desk: applies to all similar rent-restricted units.
column6: Pass --ua-method COMPANY. Owner must give the estimate to the Agency and tenants at the start of the 90-day period (c)(1).

when: Allocating Agency written estimate. Consumption data 12 months ending no earlier than 60 days before the 90-day period; rates no older than 60 days.
HUD Utility Schedule Model. Rates no older than 60 days before the 90-day period.
desk: Pass --ua-method HUSM. Desk does not run HUSM; dollar still comes from --ua.

when: Energy/water consumption model by a licensed engineer or Agency-approved qualified professional not related under 267(b)/707(b).
Actual-consumption submetering: tenant billed actual use; owner rate ≤ incurred (or local max if renewable). Admin fee ≤ greater of $5/mo or state cap is not gross rent.
desk: Pass --ua-method SUBMETER. Submetered cost is treated as paid by the tenant so UA still applies; fee itself is not UA.
